methodological_rules.municipality_counts: all exact new restaurant events with resolved municipality code
methodological_rules.fine_mesh: Matsuyama new restaurant events with map_usable_strict=true only
methodological_rules.mesh_standard: Statistics Bureau standard regional mesh: 3rd-level ~1km and 1/2 mesh ~500m
methodological_rules.hotspot: rolling-12-month strict 1km counts ranked among active meshes; z-score/percentile are descriptive, not inferential significance tests
methodological_rules.centroid: two series: strict address/parcel and town-or-better; centroid movement only between consecutive observed months
methodological_rules.rolling12: only emitted when all 12 constituent Matsuyama months are complete_exact_monthly
methodological_rules.ehime_2021_2022_fine_spatial: not used for mesh/hotspot because historical source is municipality-level only
